 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR OHRI  ORDER % 15.03.2024 1.
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

1. By way of present application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. the applicant seeks regular bail in FIR No. 115/2018 registered under Sections 376(2)(n)/109/506/174A IPC and Section 6 r/w Section 17 of the POCSO Act at P.S. Paschim Vihar.
2. Issue notice.
3. Mr. Sabharwal, learned APP accepts notice and seeks time to file Status Report.
Let the same be filed which shall also include previous involvement of the applicant, if any.
4. Renotify on 22.04.2024.

opennyai_summary.decision:
1. By way of present application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. the applicant seeks regular bail in FIR No. 115/2018 registered under Sections 376(2)(n)/109/506/174A IPC and Section 6 r/w Section 17 of the POCSO Act at P.S. Paschim Vihar.
Let the same be filed which shall also include previous involvement of the applicant, if any.
In the meantime, notice be also issued to respondent No.2 through the Investigating Officer who shall also inform the complainant about her right to free legal aid/representation in accordance with the decision of the Supreme Court in Delhi Domestic Working Women's Forum v. Union of India &
Ors.
